title: Recent-Purchase Lining Discount: Day Count from Purchase to Added Work (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
A recent-purchase lining discount applies to the lined surcharge for added work on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, read from the calendar days between the completed date of the Merchandise Purchases record the ticket names and the date the operation was booked (the booking date of the operation charge the surcharge is priced on).

| Calendar days from the purchase's completed date to the date the operation was booked | Recent-purchase lining discount |
|---|---|
| 120 days or fewer | 10 percent |
| more than 120 days | 5 percent |
| The ticket names no completed Marlowe & Finch purchase record | none |

**Records read.** The completed date on the purchase record named on the ticket; the booking date of the operation charge on the ticket. A purchase record that is not yet completed has no completed date and gives no discount.

## The 120-day threshold, both sides (hypothetical dates)

| Purchase completed | Operation booked | Days | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 29 June (120 days later) | 120 | 10 percent |
| 1 March | 30 June (121 days later) | 121 | 5 percent |
| 1 March of one year | 15 January of the next year | more than 120 | 5 percent |
| not yet completed | any | — | none |
